title: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and Golgari queen who falls off a roof into a portal, then finds and takes into her mind the Soldier, the Guildpact and the Survivor, and offers Jace a kind death.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: The sphinx whose commands compel Vraska to step off the Vrynian rooftop; in Jace's past he gave the instruction that made the Soldier a killer.

entities.name: The Assassin
entities.description: The part of Vraska's past self that killed too many names to remember; she joins Vraska's fall and shares that she knows how to gift a kind death.

entities.name: The Soldier
entities.description: A boy-aged part of Jace, the sphinx's prodigy and weapon, trapped in a memory of a Vrynian army camp of dead soldiers; Vraska embraces him and he joins her mind.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: A part of Jace imprisoned in a broken Chamber of the Guildpact on Ravnica, who quits the office and joins Vraska's mind.

entities.name: The Survivor
entities.description: The last aberration of Jace, waiting on a beach, who orchestrated the plan and accepts his death, declaring that he is in progress.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The part of Jace who pursues the plan to merge the Multiverses, achieves omniscience after Jadzi's death.

entities.name: The Warden
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who attacks the Theorist's ambition from inside his mind.

entities.name: The Clean Slate
entities.description: An aberration of Jace who tries to wipe the Theorist's knowledge of how to merge the planes.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker mind mage divided into aberrations, each a part of himself.

entities.name: Vraska, the Multiverse's double
entities.description: A double of Vraska made by the Theorist's Multiverse who serves him and prepares a knife; the Theorist feels she is a construct without something to fight for.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle of Arcavios, held by the Theorist, who taunts him and cuts her own throat with a knife, her death hurling him back to the creation of Arcavios.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who enters the sanctum and tries to stop the Theorist.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who accuses the Theorist of making the merging only to prove it could be done.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker druid who joins the assault on the Theorist.

entities.name: Cryomancer Chandra
entities.description: The Theorist's Multiverse's double of Chandra who tackles her twin into a portal.

entities.name: Veil-embraced Garruk
entities.description: The Theorist's Multiverse's double of Garruk who tackles his twin into a portal.

entities.name: Warlord Ajani
entities.description: The Theorist's Multiverse's double of Ajani who tackles his twin into a portal.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A person whom the Survivor asks Vraska to be there for.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon the Guildpact hopes will hate being the Guildpact.

entities.name: Kallist
entities.description: A friend of Jace whose death he regrets.

entities.name: Emmara
entities.description: A friend whose disappointed face Jace sees.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A friend whose disappointed face Jace sees.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A friend whose disappointed face Jace sees.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A friend whose disappointed face Jace sees.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: One who, with Alhammarret, forced Jace to hurt people.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A figure in hallucinations the Theorist fends off.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: A Golgari group of assassins; Vraska tells the Soldier he is a killer worthy of it.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: The Ravnican guild Vraska led.

entities.name: Mage hunters
entities.description: Creatures circling the tower's base in search of magic, some clawing upward.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Formless horrors the Theorist sees battling ships when two planes merge.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: The plane of Jace's memories of Alhammarret and the camp of the dead soldiers.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Guildpact is imprisoned in a ruined chamber and where Vraska is seen bleeding on a roof.

entities.name: The Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The Guildpact's office, scarred by a huge hole gouged from stone.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane with a beach memory trap where the Survivor waits.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of oracles where Jadzi dies; the Theorist is thrown back to its creation.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane Jace survived but did not defeat.

entities.name: The Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes that the Theorist crosses.

entities.name: Sissoko's Law
entities.description: A law that grips the Theorist as he is launched into the sky and out into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: The Multiverse
entities.description: The original reality and the one the Theorist created, which he weaves together.

events.summary: Compelled by Alhammarret to step off the Vrynian rooftop, Vraska aims her fall at a portal and steps off.
events.quote: She was commanded to walk, but she was not commanded to aim, and so she aims.

events.summary: While falling, Vraska thinks of her divided selves and invites her assassin self to join her fall.
events.quote: she sees herself, the assassin, and invites her to join this fall.

events.summary: The Soldier, a boy in a memory trap of a camp of dead soldiers, recognizes Vraska approaching and salutes her.
events.quote: The Soldier sees Vraska approaching and straightens into a salute.

events.summary: The Soldier asks for help and admits he is the reason she could not love all of him.
events.quote: "I'm the reason you couldn't love all of me.

events.summary: Vraska embraces the Soldier and tells him she loves him as she loves Jace.
events.quote: You're part of him, and I love you as I love him."

events.summary: The Soldier says death is a change in state and dives into Vraska's mind.
events.quote: he soundlessly disappears his body and dives into her mind.

events.summary: Vraska reaches the Guildpact in his prison in a ruined chamber; he warns that the Theorist has Jadzi.
events.quote: "The Theorist has Jadzi," the Guildpact warns.

events.summary: The Guildpact quits the Guildpact, spits on his desk, and Vraska turns the desk to stone before he joins her mind.
events.quote: Vraska stares at the desk and turns it to stone.

events.summary: The Survivor, last aberration, waits on a beach and has been hiding the plan from the Theorist.
events.quote: He's been concealing their machinations from the Theorist.

events.summary: The Survivor weighs his life by his deeds, choices and crimes, and is steeped in regret.
events.quote: He was ready to trade all of existence for the possibility of a future.

events.summary: Vraska sits beside the Survivor, who confesses he is afraid to die.
events.quote: "I'm afraid to die," he confesses.

events.summary: The Survivor declares that he does not want peace and that he is in progress.
events.quote: "I'm in progress."

events.summary: Vraska tells him she loves all of him, and he recites a Vrynian prayer of betrothal, asking her to be there for Tam.
events.quote: Encircle our union and bind our futures, pleasant and painful, spouse to spouse, marriage to death."

events.summary: Vraska offers to gift the Survivor a kind death, and he accepts before joining her.
events.quote: Let me at least gift you a kind death."

events.summary: The Theorist prepares to kill the oracle on the tower balcony as mage hunters circle below.
events.quote: He stands on the balcony of the tower.

events.summary: The Theorist realizes his sunrise lacks birdsong and the trivial moments that make it matter.
events.quote: "There's no birdsong," he says aloud to no one.

events.summary: Jadzi taunts the Theorist; he enters her mind and learns he must kill her, but he cannot muster the courage.
events.quote: But he cannot muster the courage to kill.

events.summary: Jadzi seizes the knife and cuts her own throat, telling the Theorist to keep his lids open.
events.quote: as she cleanly slices the knife across her throat.

events.summary: Jadzi's death hurls the Theorist back to the creation of Arcavios, where he sees two planes merging into one.
events.quote: when an oracle of Arcavios dies, they are hurled back to the creation of Arcavios

events.summary: The Theorist gains cosmic knowledge of how to overwrite the Multiverse.
events.quote: I know how to overwrite the Multiverse

events.summary: The aberrations attack the Theorist's mind; the Warden and the Clean Slate try to stop him, but he raises a barrier of sleep.
events.quote: The Theorist summons a barrier of sleep behind him

events.summary: The Theorist begins merging the Multiverses, weaving the new over the old.
events.quote: dragging that great fabric over the hard stone of the old Multiverse.

events.summary: The Theorist fends off assaults from the aberrations, including sleep, seizures and plague, and overpowers them.
events.quote: The Theorist fends off sleep, a seizure, hallucinations of Azor

events.summary: The aberrations vanish from his mind and the heroes rush him, but he freezes them in place.
events.quote: The heroes rush the Theorist. Without a second thought, he flicks his hand, and his friends come to a halt, standing perfectly still.

events.summary: The Theorist summons portals and his friends' doubles tackle them into the portals, then he weaves the two Multiverses together.
events.quote: Each tackles their twin into a different portal.

events.summary: The Theorist achieves omniscience and the two Multiverses are woven together.
events.quote: he weaves two Multiverses together.

relations.note: Vraska loves all of Jace; they exchange a betrothal prayer.
relations.quote: "I love all of you," she says at last.

relations.note: The Soldier is the sphinx's prodigy and weapon.
relations.quote: the sphinx's prodigy, the sphinx's weapon.

relations.note: The Guildpact hopes Niv-Mizzet hates being the Guildpact as much as he did.
relations.quote: I hope Niv-Mizzet hates being the Guildpact as much as I did.

relations.note: She stays near the Theorist and brings the oracle at his command.
relations.quote: This Vraska ducks inside, and the Theorist turns back to the horizon.

relations.note: She taunts him and kills herself to make his plan harder.
relations.quote: "You really are chickenshit without the rest of you.

relations.note: Ajani accuses him of merging the Multiverses to prove it could be done.
relations.quote: "You did it to prove it could be done!" Ajani snarls.
